Recommendations: For Plan 1 contract, the lowest bidder, Champion Technology Holdings Limited, provided the proposal in $480,000 with 4.6 years payback and $103,482 annual FiT income; For Plan 2 contract, tenderer, Sinopower Holding (Hong Kong) Co. Ltd, offered the highest sharing 30% to landlord with estimated annual income $69,049. By comparing with plan 1 and 2, we recommended awarding Sinopower in the mode of plan 2 to share almost $70000 income annually without any expenditure.
